s_login.text:
Chosen: Stage, with the portal connecting screen from Lineup.

Signing in to an account stays in the OpenAC launcher. In the client, "login" is the connecting screen and then choosing a character.

The server only sends names. Level, look and last place are remembered by OpenAC on this computer (OPENAC, agreed). Quill was never played here, so it shows a name only. Delete keeps retail's typed DELETE.

s_create.text:
Chosen: Studio.

Gender sits with heritage. A name the server refuses offers near names (OPENAC, agreed).

Only War Mage's numbers are real (50/40/10/30/100/100). Other templates' numbers and skill costs are made up: the client reads them from the game data.
